3	import unittest

5	from pathlib import Path
6	
7	from src.billing.currency import convert
8	
9	
10	class ConvertTest(unittest.TestCase):
11	    @classmethod
12	    def setUpClass(cls):
13	        root = os.environ.get("LEDGERLINE_FX_FIXTURES")
14	        if not root:
15	            raise RuntimeError(
16	                "LEDGERLINE_FX_FIXTURES is not set: point it at tests/fixtures/fx. "
17	                "The FX tests never call the live rate feed."
18	            )
19	        cls.rates = json.loads((Path(root) / "2026-09-30.json").read_text())
20	
21	    def test_exact_conversion(self):
22	        self.assertEqual(convert(1000, Decimal(self.rates["EUR"])), 920)
